crossrefs.text: He has saved us and called us to a holy calling, not because of our works, but by His own purpose and by the grace He granted us in Christ Jesus before time began.
I press on toward the goal to win the prize of Godʼs heavenly calling in Christ Jesus.
Therefore, since we have a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold firmly to what we profess.
For we do not have a high priest who is unable to sympathize with our weaknesses, but we have one who was tempted in every way that we are, yet was without sin.

What agreement can exist between the temple of God and idols? For we are the temple of the living God. As God has said: “I will dwell with them and walk among them, and I will be their God, and they will be My people.”
Do you not know that you yourselves are Godʼs temple, and that Godʼs Spirit dwells in you?
As a prisoner in the Lord, then, I urge you to walk in a manner worthy of the calling you have received:
Such a high priest truly befits us—One who is holy, innocent, undefiled, set apart from sinners, and exalted above the heavens.

notes.title: Moses and Christ, servant and Son

crossrefs.text: For He is our God, and we are the people of His pasture, the sheep under His care. Today, if you hear His voice,
So I swore on oath in My anger, “They shall never enter My rest.”
As it has been said: “Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts, as you did in the rebellion.”
Incline your ear and come to Me; listen, so that your soul may live. I will make with you an everlasting covenant— My loving devotion promised to David.
Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will come in and dine with him, and he with Me.
God again designated a certain day as “Today,” when a long time later He spoke through David as was just stated: “Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts.”
My sheep listen to My voice; I know them, and they follow Me.
If only My people would listen to Me, if Israel would follow My ways,

notes.title: Today, if you hear his voice, enter the rest

crossrefs.text: Therefore encourage and build one another up, just as you are already doing.
And let us consider how to spur one another on to love and good deeds.
Let us not neglect meeting together, as some have made a habit, but let us encourage one another, and all the more as you see the Day approaching.
This is what the LORD says: “Cursed is the man who trusts in mankind, who makes mere flesh his strength and turns his heart from the LORD.
Yet they did not listen or incline their ear, but they followed the stubborn inclinations of their own evil hearts. They went backward and not forward.
The heart is deceitful above all things and beyond cure. Who can understand it?
Preach the word; be prepared in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and encourage with every form of patient instruction.
But Christ is faithful as the Son over Godʼs house. And we are His house, if we hold firmly to our confidence and the hope of which we boast.

notes.title: Today, if you hear his voice, enter the rest
